added.title: Software Engineer (Level 1-4) with Security Clearance
Software Engineer - School of Medicine
added.description:
Temple University's LKSOM/Information Technology Department is searching for a Software Engineer 1 - Full Stack
to join our team!

Salary Grade: T26

A variety of important factors are reviewed by HR when considering salary, including job duties, the applicant's education and experience, all relevant internal equity considerations, department budget, and funding source.

Job Details

This is a full-time, hybrid position based at Temple University's Health Sciences Campus. Following successful completion of the probationary period, a flexible work arrangement may be considered based on satisfactory performance, departmental needs, and institutional approval. Any approved flexible work arrangement would require occasional on-site attendance and may be modified or discontinued based on departmental or institutional requirements.

Position Summary

The Software Engineer 1 - Full Stack develops, enhances, integrates, and supports applications, data solutions, and technical services used by students, faculty, and staff across the Lewis Katz School of Medicine. The position independently owns assigned work from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing, deployment, documentation, maintenance, and production support. The Software Engineer works closely with the Director of Information Technology, colleagues, and school stakeholders to translate business and academic needs into secure, reliable, accessible, and sustainable technical solutions.

The role supports a mixed technology environment that includes legacy and modern web applications, SQL Server databases, vendor platforms, APIs, data integrations, ETL processes, reporting, automation, and application modernization. Primary assignments may emphasize application development, data integration and reporting, or another area based on organizational priorities and the employee's experience; however, both Software Engineers share responsibility for the broader applications and data portfolio and are expected to cross-train to support service continuity.

Technologies may include Java, JSP, C#, ASP.NET, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, modern frontend frameworks, Python, SQL Server, SSIS, SSRS, RESTful APIs, PowerShell, Power Platform, Git, and related modern development and data tools.

Essential Functions

Independently analyze requirements, design technical solutions, and manage assigned development and integration projects through implementation and ongoing support
Develop, enhance, maintain, troubleshoot, and modernize web applications and related technical solutions
Maintain and support legacy Java/JSP and C#/ASP.NET applications while contributing to plans and projects that transition systems to modern, supportable technologies.
Design and develop responsive, accessible user interfaces using HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, and appropriate frontend frameworks
Develop and maintain SQL Server queries, views, stored procedures, database objects, and application data access components
Develop and support data integrations, ETL workflows, APIs, automated file transfers, and data pipelines connecting institutional and vendor systems
Create and maintain reporting and analytics solutions, including SSRS reports and other approved reporting tools
Build automation solutions using Python, PowerShell, Power Platform, or other appropriate technologies
Troubleshoot production application, data integration, reporting, and data-quality issues; perform root-cause analysis and implement sustainable resolutions
Integrate vendor-provided applications with school systems and develop additional functionality where appropriate
Apply secure development, data privacy, accessibility, testing, source control, change management, and deployment practices
Participate in code reviews and maintain source code and technical artifacts in Git or other approved version-control platforms
Document requirements, designs, code, configurations, data workflows, integrations, deployment procedures, and operational support processes
Build effective relationships with stakeholders; gather and clarify requirements, explain technical options, and provide recommendations
Manage multiple assignments and priorities, communicate status and risks, and escalate issues requiring leadership or broader institutional coordination
Cross-train with other team members and maintain sufficient documentation and shared knowledge to reduce single points of failure and support service continuity
Participate in Agile/Scrum or other established planning and development processes
Provide support for critical systems and perform occasional after-hours work for deployments, maintenance, or urgent production issues when necessary

Required Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, software engineering, data science, or a related field and at least 2 years of related professional experience developing and supporting applications, integrations, databases, reporting, or automation solutions. Demonstrated ability to independently complete assigned technical work and support production systems is required. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Required Skills And Abilities

Core Technical Skills:

Professional experience developing, integrating, maintaining, and troubleshooting software or data solutions
Working knowledge of at least one modern or enterprise programming language, such as Java, C#, Python, or JavaScript, with the ability to learn and support additional technologies
Working knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts, including querying, data validation, and database objects
Understanding of web application architecture, APIs, systems integration, testing, deployment, and production support
Experience using version control, preferably Git
Ability to analyze business and academic processes and translate requirements into practical technical solutions
Ability to independently organize and complete assigned work while seeking direction or escalation when priorities, policy, architecture, or risk require leadership decisions

Applications, Data, And Integration Capabilities

Ability to support both legacy and modern technologies and contribute to application or data-platform modernization
Understanding of secure coding, accessibility, data privacy, data quality, documentation, and change-management practices
Experience with or ability to learn application development, ETL/data integration, reporting, automation, and vendor-system integration tools used by the school
Ability to troubleshoot across application, database, integration, and reporting layers

Professional Skills

Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and time-management skills
Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build productive relationships with technical and nontechnical stakeholders
Ability to manage multiple priorities, communicate progress and risks, and deliver reliable solutions with limited day-to-day technical supervision
Commitment to documentation, knowledge sharing, cross-training, and service continuity
Ability to work occasional early mornings, evenings, nights, or weekends when necessary for deployments, maintenance, or urgent support

Preferred Skills And Abilities

Application development experience with Java/JSP, C#/ASP.NET, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, React, Angular, or similar frameworks
Data integration and automation experience with Python, SQL Server, SSIS, RESTful APIs, SFTP, PowerShell, or related tools
Reporting or analytics experience with SSRS, Power BI, Tableau, data warehousing, or similar platforms
Experience modernizing legacy applications or migrating data and integrations to contemporary platforms
Experience with Power Platform, cloud services, containerization, CI/CD, automated testing, or DevOps practices
Experience supporting vendor-provided academic, clinical, administrative, or student-information systems
Familiarity with higher education, academic medicine, FERPA, accessibility standards, and institutional data-governance requirements
Interest in responsible use of AI-assisted development and automation tools

Temple University
is committed to a policy of equal opportunity for all in every aspect of its operations, including employment, service, and educational programs. The University has pledged not to discriminate on the basis of age, color, disability, marital status, national origin or ethnic origin, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or veteran status.

Compliance Statement
: In the performance of their functions as detailed in the position description, employees have an obligation to avoid ethical, legal, financial, and other conflicts of interest to ensure that their actions and outside activities do not conflict with their primary employment responsibilities at the institution. Employees are also expected to understand and comply with applicable laws, University and employment policies and regulations, including NCAA regulations for areas and departments with which their essential functions cause them to interact.

added.title: Software Engineer with Clearance
added.description:
What is Aviture?

Aviture is a full-service technology consulting firm with expertise in software solutions for both commercial and government organizations.

We believe software doesn’t mean anything unless it solves a problem, so we create technology to enable users, open possibilities, and create meaningful impact.

“I wanted to create a company that I would have wanted to work at when I was an engineer.” — Mark Griffis, President

We are headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, with remote employees across the nation: Las Vegas, Washington D.C., Austin, Dallas, Portland, Green Bay, Kansas City, Madison, Minneapolis, and Orlando, just to name a few.

What is Aviture’s Art of the Possible?

Along with our mission-driven team’s deep expertise in a wide range of development languages, we employ a disciplined agile approach to define goals upfront, keep organizational value at the forefront, and set the pace for rapid, iterative innovation that transforms organizations. We call this the Art of the Possible.

The Solutions We’ve Created Have

Saved lives in the California wildfires and southern U.S. flooding
Provided security for the 2020 Presidential Inauguration, Super Bowl, and post-attack Boston Marathon
Enabled augmented-reality training environments for surgeons
Increased transparency and promoted patient wellness in hospitals and senior care facilities
Combined computer vision and robotics to automate dangerous manual labor tasks
And much more!

Why You’ll Want to Live Aviturian

Aviturians Create Technology That Makes a Meaningful Difference In Someone’s Life. We’re a Team Made Up Of Designers, Engineers, Developers, And Inventors Who Believe Technology’s Purpose Is To Empower Users To Change The World. Here Are The Values That Guide Us

Embody integrity
Seek ownership
Stay hungry
Remain grounded
Create impact
Challenge with respect

We’ve built our culture around creativity, continuous learning, and our shared values. If that sounds like something you’d like to be a part of, then join us today!

Software Engineer

Aviture is hiring a Software Engineer. Aviturians understand how technology can change the world and have the technical skills to make those visions a reality. Aviturians are always eager to learn, share, collaborate, grow, and innovate. (We also share a good meme or thirty.)

We’re looking for a rockstar Software Engineer who will…

Work with a cross-functional team to design, develop, test and deploy innovative solutions to a wide range of complex business problems.
Actively participate in all aspects of our agile development process.
Utilize effective debugging techniques to identify and resolve software defects.
Continuously keep themselves up to date on changes in technology, with an emphasis on the tech stacks being used by your team.

Sound like you? Apply today:

Requirements

BS degree in Software Engineering related degree, similar technical field of study or equivalent practical experience.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Able to respectfully challenge the status quo.
Experience developing and maintaining large-scale applications using one or more general purpose programming languages, such as:
Python, Java, C#/.NET, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript

Experience with one or more modern frontend technologies is a plus: ReactJS, AngularJS, VueJS, etc.
Able to work both autonomously, as well as collaboratively among a team of your peers.
Excellent grasp of computer science concepts, proven ability to solve complex technical problems.
Experience using common design patterns in the software industry.
High personal standards for code quality, maintainability, and performance.
This position will require the employee to have a Secret level Government clearance or the ability to obtain one.
This position will require the employee to work in person at an off-site location.

Benefits

PPO or a High Deductible Health Plan, HSA eligible plan, Dental, Vision, and Supplemental Life.
Generous paid time off that starts accruing on day one.
Hybrid work environment with quarterly Castaway Week events in the Omaha HQ Office, all expenses paid, from across the country to participate in team-building, collaboration, and fun events.
Company vacations!!! Previous destinations have included Napa Valley, Cancun, Cabo San Lucas and Aspen.
Matching 401k with 100% vesting in six months.
Pick your preferred workstation! Mac? PC? We’ll support you with the tech you need to do your best work.
Get paid to go to national and international conferences and training, so that you can stay up to date with the latest innovations.
Flexible work schedules: Work the times that fits your schedule, with all meetings required to be scheduled between 9 am and 3 pm CST.
Free lunch every Friday and recurring team events for you and your family to enjoy.
Incentive and bonus pay.
Opportunities for connection and growth through peer coaching, recurring Lightning Talks to share things we’re passionate about, and a bi-weekly company-wide All Hands.

added.title: Angular/Python Full Stack Developer
added.description:
Full Stack Developer — Angular / Python / AWS

Midtown Manhattan · Hybrid (2–3 days onsite) · Asset Management · NYC-area candidates only. Must be work eligible in the U.S.; no visa sponsorship or transfer of any kind (H-1B, OPT/F-1, or otherwise). You must be able to interview and work onsite in Midtown Manhattan.

About the opportunity

This is a rare seat at a respected, boutique asset management firm in the heart of Midtown, the kind of role that's hard to find and harder to leave. You'll work alongside a small, high-caliber team building and running the technology that powers real financial operations, not watching from the sidelines.

This is mid-level role for someone 4-10+ years into their career who is ready to take on more ownership than a big bank or consultancy would ever give them. Estimated base salary is $125,000–$145,000, plus an annual bonus and a comprehensive benefits package.

We work hard, think carefully, and hold ourselves to a high standard. If you've spent time in financial services — at a bank, a custodian, a prime broker, or an asset manager — and you've been frustrated by how slowly things move or how little of the stack you're allowed to touch, this is the opportunity to change that.

What you'll do

Build and maintain web applications, APIs, and batch processes using Angular and Python
Design database schemas and write tuned SQL across RDBMS platforms (Amazon RDS/Aurora, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server)
Build and operate AWS infrastructure: EC2, ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudWatch
Design for high availability and reliability in 24/7 environments - redundancy, health checks, monitoring, alerting, backup and recovery
Own incident response end-to-end: triage, recovery, root cause analysis, and permanent fixes
Execute regular maintenance: patching, releases, performance testing
Translate business requirements into technical designs and actionable implementation plans.
Collaborate with infrastructure, operations, and business teams - and be able to explain a technical decisions in plain English to a non-technical stakeholder

What we're looking for

4+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining web applications and backend systems
Strong Angular and Python skills - you write code you're proud of, not just code that works
Solid AWS experience across core services (EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudWatch)
Proven comfort with RDBMS: schema design, SQL tuning, and performance optimization
Familiarity with Linux environments and scripting/automation tools
Experience with system monitoring, incident response, and high-availability design
Strong written and verbal communication; you think clearly and express ideas precisely
A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic record
Experience in financial services - banking, asset management, custody, prime brokerage, or a fintech serving those industries - is a significant advantage
Familiarity with back-office operations (settlements, reconciliation, corporate actions, custody, payments, or compliance workflows) is especially valued

Why join us

At a smaller firm, your work is visible, your judgment is trusted, and your growth isn't gated by headcount cycles
Build real, production systems that directly support investment operations — not internal tooling, not support tickets
Learn more in two years here than you would in five at a large institution
Midtown Manhattan office - accessible from across the metro area, with hybrid flexibility
A tight-knit, experienced team that will challenge you and invest in you

added.title: Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer I (PxE A&A)
added.description:
As an Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer I , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. Your expertise will be pivotal in keeping production safe, performant, and cost-effective, while driving tangible value for Deloitte's engineering investments. You will leverage your engineering craftsmanship across cloud platform engineering, observability, and performance and reliability engineering-together with applied AI fluency that lets you reliably operate AI and agentic workloads alongside the rest of the portfolio-consistently demonstrating your strong track record in operating high-quality, resilient systems at scale. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to uphold production standards, safeguard environments, and support the admission of systems into production with confidence.

Work You'll Do:

Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability-ensuring high-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient.
Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Uphold production standards, participate in the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and support the admission of systems into production-gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow.
Engineering Craftsmanship: Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability-codified, version-controlled dashboards and SLO-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks-operating as an infrastructure-focused engineer, not a tool operator. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high-quality, supportable automation to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co-defining service-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery.
Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements-progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement-rather than big-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable.
Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Uphold production standards and integrate their constraints so that the reliable, performant, and compliant path is the operative path. Co-define service-level objectives with the teams you support, verify readiness, and support the admission decision into production-holding the segregation-of-duties line as a dedicated, embedded function while partnering with security and risk on the control objectives you enforce. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
Advanced Technical Proficiency: Develop expertise in site reliability and modern production engineering-cloud platform ownership, observability (metrics, tracing, logging), performance and capacity engineering, chaos engineering, and cloud/AI cost engineering-together with applied AI fluency to operate AI and agentic workloads reliably, including AI and Agentic SSDLC, delivering production operations with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Learn to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize reliability, performance, and operational delivery. Demonstrate understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the products and platforms you operate-and, where they are AI-infused, their distinct production failure modes such as drift, train/serve skew, latency and output variance, and token/GPU cost anomalies. Translate reliability needs, reference architectures, and operational requirements into service-level objectives, runbooks, and production tooling. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

The Team

US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The successful candidate will possess:

Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

Qualifications

Required:

A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or rel job You will bring extensive engineering craftsmanship and deep expertise across platform engineering, distributed systems, and modern AI/ML and data infrastructure, together with an exemplary track record of high-quality, reusable, outcome-focused delivery at scale. The ideal candidate is a role-model engineering leader who leads by doing -setting vision, elevating standards, developing engineers and emerging leaders, and building trusted relationships with stakeholders from engineering teams to executives.

Work You'll Do:

Strategic Vision and Alignment: Craft and articulate a vision for the Applied AI engineering platform-the frameworks, tooling, accelerators, control plane, and data platform that every other engineering team builds on-in alignment with the Business Strategy and US Deloitte Technology strategy. Treat the platform as a product, mapping the needs of consuming engineering teams to reusable, self-service capabilities. Collaborate with diverse stakeholders across product, engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and infrastructure at all organizational levels.
Advocacy and Technology Roadmap: Advocate for, develop, and communicate the integrated platform engineering strategy and its implementation roadmap, positioning the platform as a product to the engineering teams who consume it and to business stakeholders. Ensure the organization is well-informed about objectives, KPIs, adoption, maturity, compliance, and progress. Promote a culture of reuse, quality, and speed-solving recurring problems once, well, for many teams to reduce per-team build and operate toil, maximize engineering leverage, and minimize total cost of ownership.
Craft Mastery and Objectives Realization: Define, measure, and drive the achievement of platform KPIs and NFRs-adoption, reliability-by-design, developer experience, performance, scalability, and security. Establish and evolve platform reference architectures, golden paths, and reusable components-including the AI control plane (with the model/LLM gateway) and agent-runtime patterns, MLOps/LLMOps tooling, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure and RAG-as-a-Service, Eval-as-a-Service and observability tooling, prompt management, and feature store; governance-as-code enforcement, control codification, and ontology management; the data platform (data catalog and marketplace, DataOps, data management and enterprise integration, master data, pipelines, and metadata/lineage); and CI/CD at platform scale-delivered through the AI and Agentic SSDLC as self-service, governed capabilities with full automation from discovery to production to operations and quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Remain hands-on with design, architecture, and code-contributing to the leverage and velocity of the engineering teams and product groups that build on the platform-while reviewing code, driving tech-debt reduction, and experimenting with new technology.
Capability Evolution and Development: As a recognized engineering leader, mentor and develop engineers and emerging engineering leaders, coaching modern platform engineering practices-internal developer platforms, distributed systems, the AI control plane and agentic patterns, MLOps/LLMOps, cloud-native design and container orchestration, platform-scale infrastructure-as-code, and the data platform. Lead by example through thought leadership-showcasing experiments internally, speaking at conferences, publishing whitepapers or blogs, and leading R&D collaborations, including with academia. Cultivate a growth mindset and modern engineering behaviors across the organization.
Iterative Value Delivery: Embrace an iterative and incremental approach to platform engineering, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds. Apply a leaning-forward approach and empirical methods to navigate complexity and uncertainty, keeping capabilities supportable and maintainable and ensuring each increment delivers value and stays aligned with consuming-team and business goals.

Applications Development Manager

Clark Construction Company | Lansing, MI | Full-time

We buy the big systems. We build everything else. Clark has 28+ internal apps built with AI, used by 300 people every day, replacing paid tools one at a time. We are hiring the person who will own that platform and help lead the company on AI.

If you have built apps on your own and learned that building was the easy part-and finding users was the hard part-this is the job where that problem is already solved. The users are here, and they have been asking for it.

About The Role

This is a builder-first, manager-second role. You will develop on an AI-native application platform using the best-fit models and tools, ship working versions in days, and define what a Clark application should look like for employees in the field and the office. You will lead a growing applications group, currently with one developer, and serve as Clark's technical lead on AI alongside the Director of IT. The applications team is one of three IT divisions, with direct access to the people you build for and no unnecessary layers.

Based in Lansing - Ideal candidates may live near Lansing, East Lansing, Jackson, DeWitt, Potterville, Charlotte, Howell, Brighton, or other surrounding areas

What You'll Do

Build, test, and launch practical business applications and AI-enabled features.
Set standards for user experience, quality, security, and maintainability across Clark-built applications.
Lead and grow the applications team while remaining hands-on in development.
Own application security, risk management, support, bug resolution, and the change queue.
Partner directly with employees to understand operational problems and translate them into useful solutions.
Explain technical choices, opportunities, and risks clearly to employees and executives.

What You Bring

A track record of shipping business applications that people use. Side projects count; what you have built matters more than how long you have been building.
Deep, current knowledge of AI tools and models, including experience shipping AI features-not just using a chatbot.
Working knowledge of SQL and data design, with the judgment to lead specialists who go deeper.
Strong UI/UX instincts and a security mindset. You move quickly without being reckless.
The ability to work with people across the business, uncover the real problem, and translate it into something buildable.
An interest in leading without giving up hands-on development. First-time managers are welcome if they have led work and earned others' trust.

Why Work with Us?

Benefits

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to superior construction management. Our passion lies in delivering high-quality buildings safely and sustainably. We offer a comprehensive benefits package, but not limited to:

Profit sharing
Generous paid time off
401(k) with company match
Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
Support for ongoing education and professional development
Clark is a Certified Veteran Friendly Employer (VFE)

Background Check Notice

All employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check. This may include verification of employment history, education, and professional references, as well as criminal background or driving record checks, as permitted by law.

Results of the background check will be considered in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA)
and Michigan law (MCL 37.2205a)
, which prohibits employers from asking about or making hiring decisions based solely on certain criminal records. A prior conviction will not automatically disqualify a candidate from employment; each situation will be reviewed individually based on job-related factors.

added.title: Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer I (PxE A&A)
added.description:
As an Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer I , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. Your expertise will be pivotal in keeping production safe, performant, and cost-effective, while driving tangible value for Deloitte's engineering investments. You will leverage your engineering craftsmanship across cloud platform engineering, observability, and performance and reliability engineering-together with applied AI fluency that lets you reliably operate AI and agentic workloads alongside the rest of the portfolio-consistently demonstrating your strong track record in operating high-quality, resilient systems at scale. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to uphold production standards, safeguard environments, and support the admission of systems into production with confidence.

Work You'll Do:

Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability-ensuring high-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient.
Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Uphold production standards, participate in the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and support the admission of systems into production-gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow.
Engineering Craftsmanship: Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability-codified, version-controlled dashboards and SLO-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks-operating as an infrastructure-focused engineer, not a tool operator. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high-quality, supportable automation to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co-defining service-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery.
Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements-progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement-rather than big-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable.
Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Uphold production standards and integrate their constraints so that the reliable, performant, and compliant path is the operative path. Co-define service-level objectives with the teams you support, verify readiness, and support the admission decision into production-holding the segregation-of-duties line as a dedicated, embedded function while partnering with security and risk on the control objectives you enforce. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
Advanced Technical Proficiency: Develop expertise in site reliability and modern production engineering-cloud platform ownership, observability (metrics, tracing, logging), performance and capacity engineering, chaos engineering, and cloud/AI cost engineering-together with applied AI fluency to operate AI and agentic workloads reliably, including AI and Agentic SSDLC, delivering production operations with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Learn to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize reliability, performance, and operational delivery. Demonstrate understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the products and platforms you operate-and, where they are AI-infused, their distinct production failure modes such as drift, train/serve skew, latency and output variance, and token/GPU cost anomalies. Translate reliability needs, reference architectures, and operational requirements into service-level objectives, runbooks, and production tooling. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

The Team

US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The successful candidate will possess:

Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

Qualifications

Required:

A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or rel job You will bring extensive engineering craftsmanship and deep expertise across platform engineering, distributed systems, and modern AI/ML and data infrastructure, together with an exemplary track record of high-quality, reusable, outcome-focused delivery at scale. The ideal candidate is a role-model engineering leader who leads by doing -setting vision, elevating standards, developing engineers and emerging leaders, and building trusted relationships with stakeholders from engineering teams to executives.

Work You'll Do:

Your expertise will be pivotal in keeping production safe, performant, and cost-effective, while driving tangible value for Deloitte's engineering investments. Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Uphold production standards, participate in the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and support the admission of systems into production-gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow.

Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability-codified, version-controlled dashboards and SLO-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Benefits

Generous PTO + 10 paid holidays.

added.title: AI Data Engineer
added.description:
As one of the first engineers on PowerPlan’s Applied AI team, you’ll build the data foundation behind the AI solutions our own teams use every week, across finance, sales, professional services, and product. Most of the work is finding, cleaning, and defining the data each build needs, then picking the simplest structure that will hold it, and pairing with the team’s AI engineer to put larger solutions into the business’s hands.

PowerPlan builds the financial software behind the companies that keep the lights on, and nine in ten U.S. investor-owned utilities use our platform. The Applied AI team sits inside Strategic Initiatives, works closely with the executive leadership team, and brings that same standard of getting the numbers right to how the company itself runs. The standards you help set early will shape how every build after yours gets done.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Success will be measured by whether the AI solutions you build data for are in weekly use and run by the business, and by whether new builds start from trusted, shared data instead of fresh exports.

Learn how the company runs through its data in your first 30 days, deliver an owner-checked first catalog of critical data by the end of your first quarter, and keep it current enough by month 12 that business and technology leaders plan AI work from it.
Help set the team’s standards for data, connections, and code review from your first 30 days, including how AI tools connect to business systems: read-only by default, no more complex than the job requires, and reviewed by IT and security.
Pair with the team’s AI engineer on a first build in your first quarter, lead the data on the first larger build into pilot by six months, and by month 12 deliver the data behind at least two larger AI solutions in weekly use and run by the business.
Agree on the first shared data sets in your first quarter, publish the first one by six months, and have at least two shared, governed data sets in use by more than one team or AI solution by month 12.
Within your first 12 months, retire hand-built recurring reports by defining the numbers once, so an AI tool can draft the commentary, answer questions, and flag what needs a person’s attention.

You’re Our Person If…

You have two to four years of professional experience as a data engineer, analytics engineer, or in a similar role where writing code to clean and model data was central to the job, or a master’s degree in a related field and at least one year of that experience.
You’ve turned messy, real data from a business system, a spreadsheet, or a set of documents into something people or an AI tool used, and you can walk us through what broke and how you fixed it.
Before you build on a number, you trace it through the systems and processes that produce it and find out from the people who own it what it means, and you can tell us about a time a business owner’s explanation changed what you built.
Agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or OpenCode are your default way of working, and you know how to plan the work, direct the tool, and check what it produces. The team builds with Claude Code, and we provide the tools.
You write working Python and SQL and can read and change code someone else wrote.
You’ve pulled data from an API end to end, including authentication, secrets, paging, and errors.
You work in Git by habit, treat data access and documentation as part of the build, and write notes a business owner can follow.
You hold a bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, information systems, or a closely related quantitative field; a business analytics or other quantitative business degree also qualifies if it included substantial programming coursework.
You can work from Atlanta in the office at least three days a week and are authorized to work in the United States (this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship, now or in the future).

Even Better If…

You’ve built an MCP server, an agent skill, or a connector someone else used.
You have experience with a modern data platform, retrieval over documents (RAG), or data quality checks.
You’ve worked with CRM, finance, or project data, ideally in or alongside finance, professional services, sales operations, or support.
You’ve applied continuous improvement methods, such as Lean, Six Sigma, or value stream mapping.
You hold a master’s degree in a related field, such as computer science, information systems, data science, or business analytics.

PowerPlan is an EOE

Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice

Please note that this is a hybrid role that involves a combination of onsite work from our corporate office as well as work from home. While we strive to accommodate flexible working arrangements when sensible, there will be times when onsite work is required. This could include scheduled office days, team meetings, client meetings, or special events.

added.title: Machine Learning Engineer
added.description:
Machine Learning Engineer | AI Security & Fraud Detection

Location:
San Francisco, CA - Onsite
Compensation:
$180,000–$260,000 Base + Equity (Flexible up to $300,000 for Exceptional Candidates)
Experience:
3+ Years, Ideally 5+ Years
Industry:
AI Infrastructure, Agentic AI, Cybersecurity, Fraud Prevention

About the Opportunity

Shields Group Search is partnering with a well-funded, early-stage AI infrastructure startup building the trust and security layer for the rapidly emerging AI agent economy.
As AI agents increasingly act autonomously on behalf of individuals and businesses, from booking services and accessing APIs to executing financial transactions, companies need infrastructure that can determine which agents are legitimate, who they represent, what actions they're authorized to perform, and whether their behavior presents a security or fraud risk.
Our client is building real-time verification and decisioning infrastructure that enables businesses to safely interact with AI agents at scale.
The platform combines agent identity verification, behavioral intelligence, risk assessment, and security controls to distinguish legitimate automated activity from suspicious or malicious behavior.

We're looking for an exceptional Machine Learning Engineer to build the models that distinguish a trusted AI agent from an attack, in real time and under load.

This is an opportunity to join a small, highly technical founding-stage engineering team and take meaningful ownership of mission-critical ML infrastructure.
What You'll Be Working On
The models behind this platform operate directly on the production request path. They must evaluate activity and support trust decisions in real time, under the same strict latency constraints as the rest of the infrastructure.
There is no offline batch job to hide behind and no second chance if a prediction is too slow or incorrect.

You'll work on problems involving:

Real-Time Fraud & Threat Detection:
Develop ML models that identify potentially fraudulent, malicious, or unauthorized agent activity while minimizing false positives.
Behavioral & Anomaly Detection:
Identify suspicious patterns, anomalous agent interactions, and emerging risks across automated transactions and API activity.
Low-Latency ML Inference:
Build and optimize production model-serving systems capable of making accurate decisions under demanding latency and throughput requirements.
Cold-Start & Low-Label Learning:
Develop effective detection approaches when labeled examples are scarce, including unsupervised learning, weak supervision, and custom evaluation datasets.
End-to-End ML Ownership:
Build, evaluate, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve production ML systems, from data and feature pipelines through real-time serving.
Adversarial ML:
Help build systems that remain effective as malicious actors adapt their behavior to evade detection.
Agentic AI Infrastructure:
Work at the intersection of modern ML, AI agents, tool calling, identity verification, and security.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

3+ years of professional ML experience
, ideally 5+ years, building, evaluating, and deploying production models, not just research or notebooks.
Strong Python and a modern ML framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow); solid SQL.
Production ML systems end to end: feature pipelines, training, evaluation, and low-latency, real-time serving.
Comfort with low-label and cold-start problems, including anomaly detection, unsupervised methods, weak supervision, and building evaluation sets and labels from scratch.
Data analysis, statistics, and experiment design.
Strong software engineering. You ship versioned, testable, reproducible code, not throwaway models.
Experience working in highly technical engineering environments with strong software engineering standards.
Ability to take ownership, solve ambiguous problems, and ship production-grade solutions in a fast-moving startup environment.

Strongly Preferred

Applied ML in fraud, risk, abuse, account integrity, or security.
Experience building ML models for fraud prevention, threat detection, trust and safety, or other systems designed to prevent malicious activity.
Graph ML / GNNs, sequence or behavioral modeling, or anomaly detection.
LLM / NLP work, and familiarity with AI agents, including tool use, function calling, and MCP.
Experience in adversarial settings, where the threat evolves against the model.
Explainable, auditable, reproducible ML, with real model versioning.
Experience developing ML systems at highly technical, engineering-driven companies, particularly those working on large-scale infrastructure, payments, fraud prevention, cybersecurity, or AI platforms.

Bonus Qualifications

Payment protocols (x402), agent identity (DID / VC), or crypto commitments (Merkle anchoring).
Experience at an early-stage startup or building ML infrastructure from the ground up.
Familiarity with real-time transaction monitoring, behavioral risk scoring, or identity verification systems.

Compensation & Work Arrangement

Base Salary:
$180,000–$260,000, with flexibility up to approximately $300,000 for exceptional candidates.
Equity:
Competitive equity participation in an early-stage, venture-backed company.
Location:
San Francisco, CA.
Work Arrangement:
The team strongly prefers engineers working onsite five days per week. Hybrid flexibility may be considered for exceptional candidates who can regularly collaborate in person.
Start Date:
The team is hiring immediately and can move quickly for the right individual.

We are looking for a product-focused senior fullstack Engineer to join us in this transformation. What You'll Do Work with product and design on our users' biggest problems to brainstorm solutions, iterate on experiments, and release product experiences in a fast-paced environment Build extensible full-stack products. added.title: Flight Software Engineer
added.description:
Company Overview

Fortastra designs and delivers resilient, high-performance spacecraft that safeguard critical orbital assets and ensure freedom of action in space. We integrate advanced autonomy, sensing, and control into systems engineered for reliability, speed, and scale.

Our culture values simplicity, accountability, and disciplined execution. We expect leaders to think systemically, act decisively, and take ownership of mission outcomes. Aggressive innovation. Disciplined execution. Strength among the stars.

We recently closed a $30M Series A
to build the future of on-orbit security and we’re just getting started!

Our Engineering Team

You will lead Fortastra’s Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GN&C) function within the Engineering Division, owning the architecture, performance, and delivery of flight-critical control systems across our autonomous spacecraft portfolio.

The Role

Fortastra is seeking a Head of Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GN&C)
to define and lead the development of flight-critical algorithms enabling autonomous rendezvous, proximity operations (RPO), and precision maneuvering in contested environments. This is a technical leadership role, not a pure management position. You will set the technical direction for GN&C across the company, own system-level performance, and build and lead a team capable of delivering mission-critical autonomy from concept through flight. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in control theory, estimation, and orbital mechanics, combined with a track record of delivering flight-proven systems and leading high-performing engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end GN&C architecture across all spacecraft programs, ensuring performance, robustness, and mission alignment
Define and drive technical strategy and roadmap for autonomy-enabled control systems in dynamic and contested environments
Lead the design, implementation, and validation of GNC algorithms for RPO, formation flying, and precision maneuvering
Oversee development of ADCS, orbit determination, and state estimation systems with flight-level reliability
Establish and enforce engineering standards, modeling practices, and verification methodologies across the GN&C domain
Drive integration of GN&C with flight software, autonomy, avionics, and mission systems
Own simulation, Monte Carlo analysis, and performance validation under uncertainty, off-nominal conditions, and failure scenarios
Lead hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and flight test campaigns, ensuring readiness for operational deployment
Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-caliber GN&C team, setting a high bar for technical excellence and accountability
Act as the technical authority for GN&C, supporting executive decisions, customer engagements, and program reviews

Qualifications and Skills

B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or related field
10+ years of experience in spacecraft, launch vehicle, or autonomous system GN&C
Demonstrated ownership of flight-critical GN&C systems from concept through on-orbit operations
Deep expertise in control systems, nonlinear dynamics, and state estimation (e.g., Kalman filtering)
Strong experience with relative motion, orbital mechanics, and RPO or formation flying missions
Proven ability to lead technical teams and deliver complex systems under schedule and performance constraints
Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink, Python, and C/C++
Experience integrating algorithms into embedded flight software and HIL environments
Strong systems engineering mindset with the ability to operate across disciplines

Requirements

5 days on-site in Torrance, CA
U.S. Citizenship required and the ability to obtain or hold an active Top Secret clearance

Why Fortastra

We are a small, high-impact team building the next generation of autonomous orbital control systems for national security space. At Fortastra, leaders own outcomes from first principles through flight and directly shape the future of resilient, mission-critical spacecraft autonomy.

FORTASTRA TALENT & CULTURE PRINCIPLES

Values Driven by First Principles

We value engineers and operators who prioritize sound judgment, candor, technical rigor, bias for action, and intellectual honesty over corporate consensus. We care about the caliber of the system you build and the speed at which you solve problems.

Talent Density Over Headcount

A high-performing startup is built on dense talent, not organizational bloat. A single exceptional engineer designs, tests, and delivers faster than a bloated committee. We intentionally maintain a lean, elite engineering crew where every contributor directly moves the needle on the mission.

High Autonomy, High Ownership

We hire domain experts to execute, not to micromanage them. You own your systems end-to-end, from initial architecture and hardware design to testing and deployment. With absolute ownership comes the responsibility to deliver mission critical reliability.

Mission Context Over Bureaucracy

The best execution happens when teams are provided clear technical objectives, constraints, and operational context, rather than rigid top-down policies. We strip away red tape so builders can iterate, make decisions, and push hardware and flight software forward rapidly.

Disciplined Speed & Flight Rigor

About the job What You'll Need 3+ years building and delivering high quality, web-based user-centered software products in a team environment Deep knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, React, GraphQL, HTML5 and CSS Experience building large, modular and maintainable JavaScript code bases and reusable UI components Experience and willingness to dive into backend code to deliver product features and debug issues (experience in or willingness to learn Ruby on Rails or Go) Experience working closely with cross-functional partners, such as engineering, design and operations, to deliver value to customers About The Role The Consumer org owns comprehensive digital experiences for home sellers and buyers. While sellers have traditionally come to Opendoor for a cash offer on their homes, we have been expanding our suite of products to serve more customers in one of the biggest transactions of their lives. This is a particularly exciting time for the team as we transform our technical architecture and user experience to a multi-product, personalized experience. We are looking for a product-focused senior fullstack Engineer to join us in this transformation. What You'll Do Work with product and design on our users' biggest problems to brainstorm solutions, iterate on experiments, and release product experiences in a fast-paced environment Build extensible full-stack products. The role will focus on front-end technologies but will also require work in the backend to deliver entire product features Collaborate with backend, frontend and full stack engineers across the org by engaging in code reviews, mentoring other developers, and being an active voice in technical discussions across the stack Contribute solutions to upleveling technical standards, software quality and team processes Work closely with our operations team to identify ways that technology can remove friction and allow them to more efficiently help our customers Compensation The base pay range for this position is $143,400-$196,900 annually, plus RSUs and bonuses.
